SQ.label: Status quo
SQ.desc: Keeps replacing lines where the city replaced them in 2021-2025 (empirical pattern), priced one line at a time.

SQ_block.label: Status quo, block-priced
SQ_block.desc: Same geography as the status quo, but work is bundled into block programs where batches allow.

PROP.label: Proportional pace
PROP.desc: Every corridor advances at the same pace, with block pricing.

PRIO.label: Harm priority, one-off
PRIO.desc: Greedy: replace the highest-harm corridors first, one line at a time (no block programs).

CM.label: Cost-minimizing
CM.desc: MILP that minimizes present-value cost only; health harm is ignored.

HW.label: Health-welfare
HW.desc: MILP that minimizes health harm + cost (EPA LCRI valuation). The paper's main schedule.

EW.label: Equity-weighted (linear SVI)
EW.desc: Health-welfare objective plus a penalty on waiting, weighted by social vulnerability.

EWc.label: Equity-weighted (convex SVI)
EWc.desc: As above, but the vulnerability weight rises steeply (SVI cubed) for the most vulnerable areas.

DW.label: Distributional weights
DW.desc: Health harm is up-weighted in lower-income corridors (inequality aversion eta = 1).

HW_r2.label: Health-welfare, r = 2%
HW_r2.desc: Health-welfare schedule solved with a 2% discount rate.

HW_r7.label: Health-welfare, r = 7%
HW_r7.desc: Health-welfare schedule solved with a 7% discount rate.

HW_child.label: Health-welfare, child benefits only
HW_child.desc: Only children's IQ losses are valued; adult cardiovascular deaths are left out.

HW_high.label: Health-welfare, high CVD function
HW_high.desc: Adult cardiovascular mortality valued with the steeper Lanphear et al. (2018) function.

HW_huynh.label: Health-welfare, tap-lead gradient
HW_huynh.desc: Exposure per line varies with the tap-lead gradient reported by Huynh et al. (2024).
